policy: For standard curated builds, frontline crit is reserved for the reviewed strong roster only: Yasuo, Yone, Tryndamere, Viego, Garen, Rengar and Master Yi. Situational entries are retained for research but are off-meta and available only through unrestricted mode. All other tanks and bruisers must not receive crit-stat or crit-passive items unless unrestricted mode is explicitly enabled.
